_comment: Records the Adobe A4U icon-set versions pulled for generation. Updated on each manual re-download. A4U is a private registry and is never a dependency of this repo; the raw SVGs are git-ignored, so only the generated art and this metadata live in the tree. See CONTRIBUTOR-DOCS/03_project-planning/05_strategies/icon-rfc.md section 8. The workflow family is added here when it is scaffolded.
